# Collective Spin Repair Cost

This repository studies the local symmetry-changing repair needed to prepare collective-spin phase probes under persistent independent isotropic depolarization. Read the actual model and proof qualifiers with every scaling claim.

## Scientific routes

- Exact model, hard instantaneous budget B, bounded sensor support k, protected auxiliaries, deterministic output time and principal theorem: science/model.md.
- Noise normalization, Casimir identity, repair drift, finite-time initial-resource term, record-assisted QFI and heralding yield: science/converse.md.
- Finite local pump, exact complementary-string mixed-cat QFI, uniform lower bound, finite noisy collective pulse and the supplied-control no-repair SQL floor: science/construction.md.
- What is charged and what is supplied; sufficient collective norm/rate scalings; pulse duration; readout and physical-resource limits: science/resources.md.
- Physical story, repair scales, differential-signal counterexample and timing/noise boundaries: science/interpretation.md.
- Connected dependency route: science/README.md.
- Attribution and closest primary theorems: references/RELATED_WORK.md and references/references.bib.
- Reproduction and actual finite checks: verification/README.md, verification/verify.py and verification/finite_checks.json.

The headline order uses a prescribed time T >= log(N+2)/kappa, fixed repair locality, and arbitrarily strong supplied controls whose individual Hamiltonians/jumps preserve the SENSOR Casimir. Parameter encoding follows preparation. Average repair budgets, unrestricted random stopping, generic local noise, differential generators and stationary quadratic-QFI attainment are different claims. Do not infer laboratory/runtime advantage or independent proof certification from the repository's checks.

## Learning routes

- Start and selected sole educational anchor: learning/README.md.
- Breuer–Petruccione (2002), relevant Chapter 2 and Chapter 3 sections, notation translations, missing project-specific steps and worked examples: learning/BRIDGE.md.
- Exactly 30 project-defined understanding targets, dependencies and proof pointers: learning/MILESTONES.md.

The common learning material is independent of any learner’s assessment history. Research citations identify imported results; they do not add educational anchors.
